proof_spine: state derivative candidates by punctured epsilon-delta control
cancel the square difference quotient and choose delta=epsilon
cancel a general affine quotient and choose any positive delta
compare x^2 with its tangent line by an exact quadratic error

attempts.summary: Defined the local epsilon-delta control relation for a derivative candidate.
Defined has_derivative_at_R as existence of a positive delta for every positive epsilon.
Proved the punctured difference quotient of x^2 equals x+x0.
The verifier did not bridge the cited quotient equality through subtraction in one step.
Added the explicit intermediate expression (x+x0)-2*x0, then completed the epsilon-delta proof with delta=epsilon.
Consumed the general theorem at x0=3 to obtain derivative candidate 6.
Added differentiability, a parameterized affine-function family, its exact quotient identity, and its epsilon-delta derivative theorem.
Packaged any derivative candidate as differentiability and applied it to x^2.
Checked the derivative and differentiability of 3x+2 at x=4, then proved the exact quadratic error from the tangent to x^2 at 3.

accepted_blocks: parameterized affine functions and their derivative theorem
square tangent line and exact quadratic error
lesson: Litex can keep derivatives relational and still support reusable families, existential differentiability, and inspectable tangent-error calculations without a trusted global derivative selector.
